purpose: One bundled read-only A/B metadata phase to resolve prospective aes_core/spi input-control, model-version and resource identities; do not seek approval for each local implementation/test/review step.

path_scope.A_allowed: Existing code/config/input-identity manifests for the two circuits; fixed metadata keys only.
path_scope.B_allowed: Existing non-protected gnn_model experiment code/contracts and model/feature/environment identity sidecars; no checkpoint body or labels.

allowed_metadata: code/config SHA and declared input identities
requested PATTERN_LIMIT control fields without outcomes
common-fault denominator identity/count, not detected counts
model/feature-version sidecar identity, not checkpoint tensors
tool/environment/storage and previously configured resource-limit metadata
admission_requirements: Local implementation and independent review of exact source selectors and output whitelist before remote use
Verify existing SSH host identity; never bypass host-key mismatch
No referenced paths followed beyond the bounded scope
Missing or conflicting metadata stays unverified; sidecar declarations do not authenticate unread actual artifact bytes
forbidden: mixed historical launcher or result logs including consumed E64 log
after_phase: Seal findings and assemble one concrete finite collection package. Actual collection requires separate whole-package authority with resolved resources and stop conditions, not one approval per small code task.
